title: Test paging logic against a real bleve index, mock only server behaviors an index can't produce
answers: How should search-paging code be tested in unified storage?
When to use a real bleve index vs mocked ResourceIndexClient in validator tests
body:
For code that pages through resourcepb Search results, exercise the main paging path against a real bleve index (via an indexSearchClient wrapping resource.ResourceIndex.Search) with a small page size, since that produces real cursors and result-format behavior.
Use a mocked resource.NewMockResourceClient only for scenarios a real index cannot produce: an older server returning a RESOURCE_TABLE/UNSPECIFIED response, a later page failing, or a server that ignores the cursor and repeats it.
See pkg/storage/unified/migrations/validator_test.go (TestFolderTreeValidatorPagesRealIndex vs the mocked TestFolderTreeValidatorBuildUnifiedFolderParentMap* tests).
applies: tests for unified storage search-paging code under pkg/storage/unified/migrations
